name: AspectRatio

props.name: as
props.description: Provide a custom component or string to be rendered as the outermost node of the component. This is useful if you want to deviate from the default `div` tag, where you could specify `section` or `article` instead. ```jsx <AspectRatio as="article">My content</AspectRatio> ```

props.name: ratio
props.description: Specify the ratio to be used by the aspect ratio container. This will determine what aspect ratio your content will be displayed in.

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon AspectRatio rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
